newsitem.title: ITALY: EU to hold meeting on Albania on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: EU to hold meeting on Albania on Thursday.

text.p: Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini said on Tuesday the European Union will discuss the Albanian crisis on Thursday, with Dutch Foreign Minister Hans Van Mierlo due to visit the Balkan state on Friday.
Dini told the upper house of parliament (Senate) that Thursday's meeting would take place at the level of foreign ministry political directors.
Italy on Sunday asked the Dutch, who hold the rotating EU presidency, to arrange a meeting over the crisis.
The Albanian parliament declared a state of emergency at the weekend after violent unrest rocked the south of the country, with rioters seizing weapons from police and army depots.
Albanian television said police had been given powers to shoot stone-throwers on sight and arrest anyone without valid identity papers.
Dini said the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) was considering sending a mission to Albania to evaluate the civil rights situation in the country. REUTER
